description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling JSON data, including wrapping/unwrapping JSON, loading/saving JSON files, converting test timing data into trie structures, and a class representing test results. It is part of a testing framework for layout tests in a web rendering engine.

classes.name: TestResult
classes.description: Represents a single test result with attributes for test name, failure status, run time, and a modifier indicating test status (e.g., fails, flaky, disabled). Includes a method to determine if the test is fixable.

methods.name: has_json_wrapper
methods.description: Checks if a string is wrapped with the JSON prefix and suffix.

methods.name: strip_json_wrapper
methods.description: Removes JSON wrapper from a string if present.

methods.name: load_json
methods.description: Reads a file, strips JSON wrapper if present, and parses JSON content.

methods.name: write_json
methods.description: Serializes a JSON object to a string and writes it to a file, optionally wrapping with a callback.

methods.name: convert_times_trie_to_flat_paths
methods.description: Converts a nested trie of test times into a flat dictionary with paths as keys.

methods.name: add_path_to_trie
methods.description: Inserts a file path and value into a trie structure.

methods.name: test_timings_trie
methods.description: Builds a trie structure from a list of test results with their execution times.
